body: Feature-first execution packet preparation: this is the next implementation after the consolidated draft is saved/adopted, not another research ticket. Use the isolated partial branch only as reference; do not merge its publication code wholesale. Concrete management contract: retire requires learningId/expectedRevision/reason; replace requires learningId/expectedRevision/reason plus editable replacement content, creates a linked new record/version and retires the predecessor atomically. Source/card/evidence identity and generated IDs/lifecycle are server-owned, not arbitrary client replacement fields; retain immutable original provenance and append the human reason to indexed history. Keep list/get and desktop-only management capability wiring, strict schemas and optimistic revision behavior. Reuse the accepted validation contract and existing testContext/command fixtures; no new harness, phase probe, scheduling work or full gate. DM-741 owns publication immediately afterward; then continue the existing feature graph through actual UI. The draft is validated and ready; current saved/run revisions are still 7/6, so claims await Save/adoption.
